title: Taylor warned off driving up the road at Creech
place_text: Creech Air Force Base, Indian Springs, Nevada

tellings.quote: and he said to the guy, "Um, do you mind if I just drive up the road, you know, a mile or two? I won't get out of the car." And the guy said, "Oh, that would be a very bad idea."

plain: The wife of Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years with tall white aliens while stationed in the Nevada desert, tells on Jesse Michels's podcast about a visit by a man named Timothy Taylor to Creech Air Force Base in Indian Springs, Nevada. She says Taylor asked a man there if he could just drive a mile or two up the road without getting out of the car, and was told, "Oh, that would be a very bad idea." It is told as a hint that something up that road is being guarded.
